name: JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd.
summary: JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd. functions as a comprehensive financial institution, offering a broad spectrum of banking services and products. It caters to both individual consumers (retail clients) and businesses (corporate clients) within Japan and internationally. Its deposit offerings are diverse, encompassing flexible options like transfer, savings, and ordinary accounts. For those seeking long-term growth, it provides fixed-term accounts, including traditional time deposits and TEIGAKU deposits. Additionally, the bank issues negotiable certificates of deposit. The bank extends a variety of lending solutions. These include secured loans, backed by either customer deposits or Japanese government bonds, as well as credit card facilities. Its lending scope also covers public sector entities, providing financing to local, central, and regional government authorities. Furthermore, it participates in syndicated loans and offers financing for corporate needs and secondary market activities, alongside overdraft and housing loans. Beyond traditional banking, JAPAN POST BANK facilitates investments through offerings such as securities and investment trust products, alongside sales of Japanese government bonds. It also provides comprehensive financial services including domestic and foreign exchange, insurance products, and intermediary assistance for mortgages and credit cards. Further enhancing customer convenience are its remittance and settlement functionalities, coupled with robust online banking services. The institution maintains an extensive physical and digital footprint, supported by a vast network of 31,774 ATMs and 23,734 branch locations. Established in 2006, the bank initially operated as Yucho Co, Ltd. before adopting its current name, JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd., in October 2007. Its headquarters are situated in Tokyo, Japan, and it operates as a key subsidiary of Japan Post Holdings Co., Ltd.
